name: PathwayCommons_search
description: Search Pathway Commons for pathways, interactions, and molecular entities across 22 integrated databases (Reactome, KEGG, WikiPathways, PID, BioGRID, IntAct, HPRD, etc.). Results use the upstream fixed page size of 100: start with page=0 and continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true. metadata.total_hits is exact. Optionally filter by BioPAX entity type and data source. Use PathwayCommons_get_pathway with a returned URI for full pathway details.

query.description: Search query: gene symbol (BRCA1, TP53), protein name, pathway name, or keyword

type.description: BioPAX entity type filter (default: all types)

datasource.description: Data source filter: reactome, kegg, wikipathways, pid, biogrid, intact, hprd, panther, netpath, corum, ctd, drugbank, msigdb, mirtarbase

organism.description: Organism filter: taxonomy ID (9606 for human, 10090 for mouse) or organism name

page.description: Zero-based page number. Pathway Commons fixes the page size at 100; use metadata.next_page to retrieve all results.

name: PathwayCommons_get_pathway
description: Get detailed pathway information from Pathway Commons by URI. Returns the pathway name, participants (proteins, small molecules, complexes), and processes (interactions, catalysis, controls). Use URIs from PathwayCommons_search results. Covers Reactome, KEGG, WikiPathways, PID, and other sources. Response is parsed from BioPAX/JSON-LD format.

uri.description: Pathway Commons URI from search results, e.g., http://bioregistry.io/reactome:R-HSA-5693532 (DNA Double-Strand Break Repair)

sub_pathways.description: Names of sub-pathways within this pathway

participants.description: Names of molecular participants (proteins, complexes, small molecules)

name: PathwayCommons_get_neighborhood
description: Get an interaction neighborhood from Pathway Commons. The API's extended TXT response contains both an interaction table and a separate participant-attribute table; only genuine interaction rows are returned. Large graphs are recoverably paginated: max_results is page size; start with offset=0 and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true. metadata.total_interactions is the complete interaction-table size and metadata.complete_graph_retrieved confirms that local pagination uses the full upstream graph.

gene.description: Pathway Commons source identifier. A full BioPAX URI from PathwayCommons_search is precise; a bare gene symbol or other identifier is exploratory because the API performs search and ID mapping and may start from multiple entities. metadata.source_resolution records the mode.

limit.description: Graph search depth (1 = direct neighbors, 2 = neighbors of neighbors). Default 1. Higher values return much more data.

datasource.description: Filter by data source: reactome, kegg, biogrid, intact, hprd, pid, corum, ctd, drugbank

organism.description: Optional organism filter, preferably an NCBI taxonomy ID such as 9606.

direction.description: Graph traversal direction; default is undirected.

subpw.description: Whether graph traversal may enter sub-pathways. Omit to use the upstream default.

max_results.description: Maximum number of interactions to return (default: 100)

offset.description: Zero-based interaction offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

name: PathwayCommons_paths_between
description: Find mechanistic paths connecting genes in Pathway Commons. Edge results are recoverably paginated: max_results is page size; start with offset=0 and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true. Uncached graph queries can be slow.

genes.description: Two or more source identifiers, e.g. ["BRCA1", "BRCA2", "TP53"], or a comma-separated string. Full BioPAX URIs are precise; bare identifiers invoke exploratory search and ID mapping.

limit.description: Path length limit (graph search distance). Default 1 (direct mechanistic links). Higher values include longer indirect paths and much more data.

datasource.description: Filter by data source: reactome, kegg, biogrid, intact, hprd, pid, corum, ctd, drugbank

organism.description: Optional organism filter, preferably an NCBI taxonomy ID such as 9606.

subpw.description: Whether graph traversal may enter sub-pathways. Omit to use the upstream default.

max_results.description: Maximum number of edges to return (default: 200)

offset.description: Zero-based edge offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

source.description: Entity A (left side of SIF triple)

target.description: Entity B (right side of SIF triple)

edges.description: Mechanistic interaction edges connecting the gene set

relation_counts.description: Count of each relation type among returned edges

entity_count.description: Number of distinct entities across all edges

note.description: Explanatory note when no paths are found, else null
